domain(person,[mila,omar,travis,crue]).
% Mila does not think critically.
axiom(s1,not(thinks_critically(mila))).
% Mila communicates effectively.
axiom(s2,communicates_effectively(mila)).
% If someone is detail-oriented, then they are organized and focused.
axiom(s3,rule([detail_oriented(X)],and(organized(X),focused(X)))).
% If Detective Mila either prioritizes tasks or meets deadlines (but not both), then she achieves her objectives.
axiom(s4,rule([xor(prioritizes_tasks(mila),meets_deadlines(mila))],achieves_objectives(mila))).
% If Detective Omar sets clear goals, then she either manages her time effectively or achieves her objectives, but not both.
axiom(s5,rule([sets_clear_goals(omar)],xor(manages_time_effectively(omar),achieves_objectives(omar)))).
% Detective Omar does not value accuracy.
axiom(s6,not(values_accuracy(omar))).
% If Detective Mila remains calm, then she has experience and communicates effectively.
axiom(s7,rule([remains_calm(mila)],and(has_experience(mila),communicates_effectively(mila)))).
% Mila sets clear goals.
axiom(s8,sets_clear_goals(mila)).
% If Detective Travis remains calm, then she has experience and communicates effectively.
axiom(s9,rule([remains_calm(travis)],and(has_experience(travis),communicates_effectively(travis)))).
% Mila manages her time effectively.
axiom(s10,manages_time_effectively(mila)).
% Travis does not have experience.
axiom(s11,not(has_experience(travis))).
% If Detective Mila either examines evidence or analyzes data (but not both), then she is detail-oriented.
axiom(s12,rule([xor(examines_evidence(mila),analyzes_data(mila))],detail_oriented(mila))).
% Mila is not focused.
axiom(s13,not(focused(mila))).
% Anyone who prioritizes tasks or maintains records is organized.
axiom(s14,rule([or(prioritizes_tasks(X),maintains_records(X))],organized(X))).
% Anyone who is organized either handles pressure well or achieves their objectives (or both).
axiom(s15,rule([organized(X)],or(handles_pressure_well(X),achieves_objectives(X)))).
% Mila does not have experience.
axiom(s16,not(has_experience(mila))).
% If Detective Mila sets clear goals, then she either manages her time effectively or achieves her objectives, but not both.
axiom(s17,rule([sets_clear_goals(mila)],xor(manages_time_effectively(mila),achieves_objectives(mila)))).
% If Detective Mila handles pressure well, then she is either someone who remains calm or someone who thinks critically (but not both).
axiom(s18,rule([handles_pressure_well(mila)],xor(remains_calm(mila),thinks_critically(mila)))).
% Omar communicates effectively.
axiom(s19,communicates_effectively(omar)).
% Omar is not focused.
axiom(s20,not(focused(omar))).
% If Detective Crue handles pressure well, then she is either someone who remains calm or someone who thinks critically (but not both).
axiom(s21,rule([handles_pressure_well(crue)],xor(remains_calm(crue),thinks_critically(crue)))).
% Detective Omar is not procedural.
axiom(s22,not(procedural(omar))).
% Travis does not follow protocol.
axiom(s23,not(follows_protocol(travis))).
% Crue sets clear goals.
axiom(s24,sets_clear_goals(crue)).
